Definition: a nodding or toss (of the head in derision)
BiblicalUsage: mânôwd is a nodding or tossing of the head in derision, and it occurs once, in Psalms 44:14. There God has made His people a byword among the heathen, a shaking of the head among the peoples. The word is the gesture of contempt, the head shaken at a defeated people.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe mânôwd shows me that God's people have borne contempt before, and that the shaking head of the world is not the last word.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
